entities.summary: Bruce Michael Buck is an American lawyer and founding managing partner of the London office of law firm Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom. He was also the Chairman of Premier League football club Chelsea from 2004 until 2022. His practice areas are European mergers and acquisitions, project finance and capital markets.
